What Is Topup Ma iPhone 18 Pro?

Topup Ma iPhone 18 Pro is Khalti’s special top-up campaign where your eligible mobile top-ups can give you a chance to get your hands on the all-new iPhone 18 Pro. The campaign is available directly inside the Khalti App through Featured Services.

Simply open Khalti, find Topup Ma iPhone 18 Pro, and make your mobile top-up from there. It’s your regular recharge, with a little more excitement attached.

 

How Does It Work?

It’s pretty simple.If you’re making a mobile top-up during the campaign, use the Topup Ma iPhone 18 Pro service and make a top-up of Rs. 50 .That’s it. Every successful eligible top-up gives you a chance at the iPhone 18 Pro and earns you 25 KP.

And if you make more eligible top-ups during the campaign, you get more chances.

 

Here’s How to Get Started

  • Open the Khalti App and log in.
